answer: Action-gap entropy gate. New identities must submit 64 action timestamps whose inter-arrival gaps meet a minimum entropy and low cross-correlation with existing clusters; a saffron-tagged calibration batch sets burst thresholds. Traffic resembling a lagoon’s smooth variance passes, while synchronized bursts are throttled. Attacker pays per identity: roughly 12 hours of tundra-slow randomized heartbeats plus compute to decorrelate schedules before full throughput.
